works.name: Lowmere: The Lore Spine
works.tagline: The shared world behind Wren, Isolde and Pell
works.description:
Eight World Info entries for the last town before the map runs out: Lowmere itself, the Archive of Lost and Found, Mr. Aske's rule, the Farlight, the White, the Low Tide Market, Mother Gannet and the Lantern Boy.

Import it as a standalone lorebook in SillyTavern or Aetheria and attach it to any card set on the coast. The town entry is constant; everything else is keyed.
